newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cosco unit to develop Singapore property.
newsitem.headline: Cosco unit to develop Singapore property.

text.p: Shipping company Cosco Investment (Singapore) Ltd said on Thursday its wholly-owned unit Harington Property Pte Ltd had purchased a vacant freehold property in Singapore for Singapore $35.8 million.
Cosco said in a statement it would build a 14-storey block of 52 apartments on the 21,806 sq feet site at a cost of about S$11 million.
It said it expected the development to yield a profit of S$9 million over the next two to three years. Construction would begin in early 1998.
The purchase would be funded through a combination of internal resources and bank borrowings.

It said the transaction was not expected to have a material impact on the net earnings per share or net tangible assets per share of the company for the current financial year ending December 31, 1997.
